entries.reason: iOS 6 does not export the name - the header declares each format as an exported constant rather than as an enum case, so a strong reference is a link failure on the release - and no held rung carries the symbol either, the ladder ending at 10.3.4, so the SDK's own NS_AVAILABLE(14_0, 17_0) places it at iOS 17.0
entries.effect: the pixel format code 775, which is what the host's own CoreImage holds for this name and is not the characters of the name itself; a context, a destination or a bitmap written with it is read by the release as it reads any code it is given
entries.source: the host's own CoreImage, by tests/backports/host/ciimageformats, which COMPILES the port's two band objects and LINKS them into a reader so the code compared against Apple's is the port's own: 'GREEN (port vs host): 4 agree, 0 differ' and 'ciimageformats: 4 codes, 4 mutants run, 4 RED', the last line being one mutant per code, each of which must be seen to change the comparison
